title.narrative: Support the contribution of the Montreal Protocol towards a sustainable air-conditioning sector

description.narrative: Due to the global rise in temperature, the need for cooling is increasing worldwide. Many countries lack strategies and solutions to make indoor climate control sustainable. The project supports selected partner countries in systematically analyzing their current and future cooling requirements, creating suitable framework conditions and developing comprehensive sector concepts. It promotes measures to reduce cooling requirements and strengthens efficient technologies, such as central cooling systems or district cooling. It also supports the spread of appliances with the climate-friendly refrigerant HC-290, uses existing production structures and builds up maintenance and production capacities. The project raises awareness among political decision-makers and end users in order to increase awareness of climate-friendly indoor climate control and promotes the international exchange of experience.
